svg.title: RIEMANN-MASULLO-DIAGRAMS D3 — Chapter 3 · Ch03_IdelicZeta, declaration by declaration
svg.desc: riemann-masullo at 72a10ff: the 990 declarations of the 86 items on C3, each with its kind, file, line and state; 70 declarations with a Deviation: line, quoted; and the items of other directories each item uses.

g.text: riemann-masullo at 72a10ff: the 990 declarations of the 86 items on C3, each with its kind, file, line and state; 70 declarations with a Deviation: line, quoted; and the items of other directories each item uses.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Posters: M1, what the targets rest on · M2, the steps with no known repair · M3, the paper by depth · M4, every chapter · M5, the refutations · B1, the works the manuscript cites. Names, items, files, entries and posters are links, underlined under the pointer: a card's title or a Lean name opens the source at the pin.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How to read it. The expansion of C3's cards, in the same order: one block per item, its heading opening the card, and under it, in italics, the first sentence of its first declaration's docstring, quoted. Then the declarations whose docstring states how the Lean departs from the print, each with its Deviation: line quoted from the Lean

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: source (Apache-2.0), then every declaration of the item. A name opens its line at the pin. A declaration's state is read from the terms: open when it uses sorryAx, resting when something open is below it. That a declaration states what its Deviation: line says is the docstring's claim, not checked here.

g.text: Given two archimedean tests related by Fourier transform up to a nonzero scalar, there is a global test whose zeta integral and whose Fourier transform's zeta integral have the respective archimedean zeta factors and finite Euler products on the right half-plane.

g.text: The formula evaluates ordinary derivatives on the test function. With the printed scaling D = (2πi)⁻¹∂ₓ, the degree-one residue is +4πi times (Df)(0). For the distribution derivative defined by negative transpose it is −4πi times (Dδ₀)(f), as in (3.3.2.7). Equation (3.3.2.20) evaluates D on the test. g.text: The holomorphic family at a finite place is normalized on the integer-ring indicator in the unramified case and on the inverse character supported on the integer units in the ramified case.

g.text: Equation (3.4.3.13) includes the integer-unit Tamagawa mass.

g.text: The complex Gaussian uses the corrected angular weight, and the meromorphic identity (3.4.3.13) is expressed off a discrete set of exponents.
